refusal_rule: A refused job goes back to pending uncounted and the runner tries the NEXT job: if a lane answers it, the refusal was the job's own and is counted; if it is refused too, the lanes are out: the outage breaker opens (cooldown breaker_cooldown_min, doubling, capped) and the run stops. While a breaker is open a run tries one job: an answer closes the outage breaker, a success closes the failure breaker. A job refused at the head head_strike_limit runs in a row is counted, so a prompt every lane rejects cannot block the queue forever. max_consecutive_failures counted failures in a row trip the failure breaker.
